requests.query: Representation of the emergency action instruction for passengers (the action to take in an emergency).
requests.reason: The requirement (IMO-078 clause 8.3.3.3.3.6-.7) explicitly states that passengers shall be instructed in the use of personal survival equipment **and the action to take in an emergency**. The current SHACL model only validates the boolean property nltl:personalSurvivalEquipmentInstructionCompleted. No property or constraint captures the “emergency action” aspect.

entries.meaning: Vocabulary/type/domain/range existence is not evidence of legal eligibility or of an applicability binding. Other-requirement mappings cannot be transferred automatically.
